chain.label: Aggressive certification schedule with inadequate technical oversight and safety management
chain.trigger: The schedule pressure, combined with inadequately developed organizational processes for technical oversight and safety management, led to a strong focus on keeping the program moving and a reluctance to challenge key assumptions

chain.label: Flawed method used to derive G650 V2 takeoff speed schedule
chain.trigger: a key assumption that Gulfstream used to develop takeoff speeds was flawed and resulted in V2 speeds that were too low and takeoff distances that were longer than anticipated

caused_by.evidence: reluctance to challenge key assumptions...contributed to key errors, including the development of unachievable takeoff speeds

chain.label: Gulfstream overestimated in-ground-effect stall AOA due to superficial review of two prior uncommanded-roll stall events
chain.trigger: Gulfstream did not determine (until after the accident) that the cause of two previous uncommanded roll events was a stall of the right outboard wing at a lower-than-expected AOA

caused_by.evidence: Gulfstream did not have an adequate process to ensure that...a senior-level engineering review of those events would be performed before the flight tests continued

chain.label: Gulfstream pursued pilot-technique changes instead of investigating the V2 root cause
chain.trigger: Rather than determining the root cause for the V2 exceedance problem, Gulfstream attempted to reduce the V2 speeds and the takeoff distances by modifying the piloting technique used to rotate the airplane for takeoff

caused_by.evidence: the G650 consistently exceeded target takeoff safety speeds (V2)

chain.label: Target pitch for flaps-10 takeoffs cut from 10° to 9° without raising takeoff speeds
chain.trigger: the difficulties in achieving the target V2 speeds were exacerbated in late March 2011 when the company reduced the target pitch angle for some takeoff tests without an accompanying increase in the takeoff speeds

caused_by.evidence: V2 speeds that were too low

chain.label: Rotation technique progressively shortened the pause at 9° pitch; on the accident run the PIC rotated continuously to 11.2° pitch/AOA with no pause
chain.trigger: there was no pause at the 9º pitch target, and the pitch rate slowed only as the airplane pitched through 9º about 1 second before liftoff. The airplane then stalled during liftoff at a pitch angle and an AOA of about 11.2º

caused_by.evidence: the test team focused on using progressively shorter pauses at the 9º target pitch before increasing pitch further
the PIC had 'an almost impossible task' to pull back on the control column immediately after liftoff to achieve V2

chain.label: Stick shaker and pitch limit indicator thresholds set too high to warn of the actual stall
chain.trigger: the airplane's AOA threshold for stick shaker (stall warning) activation and the corresponding pitch limit indicator...were set too high, and the flight crew received no tactile or visual warning before the actual stall occurred

caused_by.evidence: Gulfstream overestimated the in-ground-effect stall AOA

chain.label: Stall on right outboard wing at AOA 11.2°, below predicted stall AOA and stick shaker threshold
chain.trigger: when the airplane's AOA reached 11.2º during the accident takeoff, the AOA exceeded the stall AOA for the combination of flap setting, height above the ground, Mach number, and roll angle present at the time, resulting in a loss of roll control

caused_by.evidence: the flight crew received no tactile or visual warning before the actual stall occurred

chain.label: Right rolling moment from the stall overpowered lateral control despite full opposite wheel and rudder
chain.trigger: a stall on the right outboard wing produced a rolling moment that the flight crew was not able to control

caused_by.evidence: resulting in a loss of roll control

chain.label: Right wingtip struck and dragged along the runway
chain.trigger: the airplane's right wingtip contacted the runway

caused_by.evidence: which led to the right wingtip contacting the runway

chain.label: Airplane departed the runway to the right and crossed airport property
chain.trigger: the airplane departing the runway from the right side...traveled along about 3,000 feet of airport property

caused_by.evidence: the airplane departing the runway from the right side

chain.label: Airplane struck a concrete structure and the airport weather station
chain.trigger: the airplane impacted a concrete structure and an airport weather station, resulting in extensive structural damage

caused_by.evidence: impacted a concrete structure and an airport weather station

chain.label: Postcrash fire consumed the fuselage; all four occupants died of smoke inhalation and thermal burns
chain.trigger: a postcrash fire that completely consumed the fuselage and cabin interior...the cause of death for all four on-board test team members was inhalation of smoke and soot and extensive thermal burns

caused_by.evidence: Impact with the concrete structure caused extensive structural damage to the center wing box, including rupture of the fuel tank
